author: vasiok777
quote: A cash grab with unacceptable technical **** is baffling how a studio with virtually unlimited resources could release a game in such a rough technical condition. The performance is unstable, visual glitches are common, and the overall polish is nowhere near what the budget suggests. Trying to resell the exact same experience a third time without even ensuring stable performance was a terrible idea. Loyal fans deserve a finished, well-optimized game, not a rushed port designed purely to maximize profits with minimal effort.
